title: Yeasty Springy Canadian Ciabatta Bake
description: A classic ciabatta baked to perfection with a rich, yeasty flavor, perfect for a delicious Canadian brunch. This halal-friendly recipe is easy to make and yields a beautifully springy and tender crumb.

ingredients.name: Active Dry Yeast
ingredients.notes: Instant yeast may be used as a substitute.

ingredients.name: All-Purpose Flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-protein flour for a more authentic Italian bread.

instructions: Combine yeast, sugar, and warm water in a large mixing bowl. Mix until the yeast dissolves and let it sit for 5 minutes, or until the mixture becomes frothy.
Add the salt, butter, olive oil, eggs, rosemary, and coarse salt to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add the flour to the bowl, mixing until a smooth, elastic dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes, or until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a long, thin rectangle.
Place the ciabatta on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the ciabatta for 12-15 minutes, or until it is golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom.
Remove the ciabatta from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes before slicing.
To serve, slice the ciabatta into thick rounds and serve warm, or let it cool completely and store it in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
